By Darin Zullo October 11, 2026 | 9:03 AM 1 minute to read A Dorchester woman pleaded guilty Thursday to one count of manslaughter for the death of her 5-week-old infant in January 2025, according to prosecutors.
Raynell Reed, 32, entered a guilty plea in Suffolk Superior Court on one count of involuntary manslaughter, the Suffolk County District Attorney’s Office said in a statement.
